items.title: Texas Tech Game to be Televised on ESPN at 9:30 p.m., ET
items.summary: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. – The Big 12 Conference has announced that WVU's Nov. 7 Big 12 Conference football game at Texas Tech at Galaxy Stadium in Lubbock, Texas, will be televised on ESPN at 9:30 p.m., ET.

items.title: Six-Day Window to be Exercised for Nov. 7 Game at Texas Tech
items.summary: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. – The Big 12 Conference has announced that ESPN and FOX will utilize a six-day window to announce the broadcast network and time slot for WVU's Saturday, Nov. 7 Big 12 Conference football game at Texas Tech at Galaxy Stadium in Lubbock, Texas.

items.title: West Virginia's Defense Comes up Big in Road Victory at TCU
items.summary: West Virginia's much maligned defense came up with the plays needed to pull off a 24-20 upset victory over TCU Saturday afternoon at Amon G. Carter Stadium in Fort Worth, Texas.

items.title: Cassidy's Walkoff Field Goal Downs Cincinnati
items.summary: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. – Jack Cassidy's 35-yard field goal on the game's final play lifted West Virginia to a dramatic, 45-42 come-from-behind victory over Cincinnati Saturday afternoon at sunny Milan Puskar Stadium.

items.title: CUE COUNTRY ROADS! Mountaineers Defeat Cincinnati, 45-42
items.summary: MORGANTOWN, W.Va. — West Virginia defeated Cincinnati for its first Big 12 win, 45-42, on Saturday in Morgantown.
